description: relay_client.rs:34: doc comment 'Each call to enforce_for_delivery performs a DNS lookup' is inaccurate — cache hits skip DNS entirely (lines 71-77). Correct to: 'On cache miss performs a DNS lookup and HTTPS fetch; on cache hit returns from memory.'
title: MtaStsEnforcer doc says 'performs a DNS lookup' but cache hits skip DNS
